2607.22157.title: Learning on the Job: Continual Learning from Deployment Feedback for Frozen-Weights Agents
2607.22157.paper_summary: AI agents encounter learning opportunities in every episode they run, and discard nearly all of them: the underlying models are frozen at deployment, so an agent that resolves a difficult request today starts from zero when it recurs tomorrow. Yet ordinary operation already produces feedback, in the form of outcome verdicts and after-the-fact corrections. We show that this feedback is a sufficient signal for continual learning when the frozen model is paired with an external memory that distils each episode into retrievable natural-language rules. On the banking domain of $τ$-bench, against a static-RAG control retrieving over the complete policy corpus, learning from the one-bit outcome verdict lifts single-trial success to 1.6$\times$ the baseline, and learning from corrections to 2.6$\times$, converting 22 of the 84 tasks the baseline never solves. The result spans the deployment spectrum, measured on Mistral Large, an open-weights model that organisations with data sovereignty requirements can self-host, and replicated on a frontier model, Claude Sonnet 5. The accumulated memory also transfers: each model, reading the store built by the other, rises above its own no-memory baseline. The harness, protocol, and data are released.
2607.22157.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理在每一個運行的回合中都會遇到學習機會，但幾乎都會被丟棄：基礎模型在部署時是固定的，因此今天解決一個困難請求的代理，明天當請求再次出現時將從零開始。然而，普通操作已經產生了反饋，這些反饋以結果裁決和事後修正的形式出現。我們顯示，當固定模型與外部記憶配對時，這種反饋是一個足夠的信號，能夠進行持續學習，外部記憶將每個回合提煉為可檢索的自然語言規則。在 $τ$-bench 的銀行領域中，對比於一個靜態 RAG 控制器從完整的政策語料庫中檢索，從單位結果裁決中學習使單次試驗的成功率提升至基線的 1.6$\times$，而從修正中學習則提升至 2.6$\times$，轉換了基線從未解決的 84 個任務中的 22 個。該結果涵蓋了部署範圍，測量於 Mistral Large，一個可以自我托管的開放權重模型，適合有數據主權要求的組織，並在前沿模型 Claude Sonnet 5 上進行了複製。累積的記憶也可以轉移：每個模型在讀取另一個模型建立的存儲後，都能超越自己的無記憶基線。該工具、協議和數據已經發布。
